data.name: views
data.title: Views
data.description: The number of times your post was played or displayed.

data.name: reach
data.title: Accounts reached
data.description: The number of unique accounts that have seen this carousel container, at least once. Reach is different from impressions, which may include multiple views of your carousel container by the same accounts. This metric is estimated.

data.name: saved
data.title: Saved
data.description: The number of saves of your post.

data.name: shares
data.title: Shares
data.description: The number of shares of your post.

data.name: likes
data.title: Likes
data.description: The number of likes on your post.

data.name: comments
data.title: Comments
data.description: The number of comments on your post.

data.name: total_interactions
data.title: Post interactions
data.description: The number of likes, saves, comments and shares on your post minus the number of unlikes, unsaves and deleted comments.

data.name: follows
data.title: Follows
data.description: This is how many accounts started following you.

data.name: profile_visits
data.title: Profile visits
data.description: The number of times your profile was visited.

data.name: profile_activity
data.title: Profile activity
data.description: [IG Insights] This header is the name of a metric that appears on an educational info sheet for a particular post, story, video or promotion. This metric is the sum of all profile actions people take when they engage with this content.

data.name: reposts
data.title: Reposts
data.description: The number of times your post was reposted.
